title: From9Cαgroups to4beads: training fit versus held-out transfer
evidence: 12LAMMPS replica-holdout structural fits from short atomistic peptide references

units.CG_time: nominal ps, not physical kinetic calibration

limitations: Each bead is the equal-weight centroid of9Cαatoms:3residues×3chains. Fourbeads cover residue ranges2–4,5–7,8–10,11–13.
Three bonds/twoangles only; no solvent, nonbonded interactions, torsion or chemical crosslinks in the CGmodel.
Two fullreplicas fit each fold; the third is held out. Frames remain correlated.
Force intervals across folds are ranges, not confidence intervals or tissue-strength predictions.
Training match reaches0.24SD while excluded-replica mean errors reach1.84SD; short windows and missing coupling remain limits.
Histogram counts are directly derived from saved coordinates with common32bin edges per fold/coordinate; no Gaussian assumption/refitting.

source.scope: Exact saved-row subset; no aggregation, interpolation or new fit.

qualification.label: Saved checks pass
qualification.scope: Only the named saved runtime/numerical/mechanical checks; no broader biological or chemical validation implied

summary.scope: short-window structural transfer only; no validated fibril/tissue elasticity or kinetic timescale
summary.Brev_access: not authenticated in the current runtime or cloud browser; no remote job launched

provenanceNote: Extracted from public PDB/workbook/archive or recovered user-owned scientific outputs. Source reportURLs identify context; exact local-source hashes are retained in the extraction manifests. No unpublished credential or execution log is included.
